researchVerdict: All 51 identified LP outer fronts/backs are usable and visually verified; no known wrong-album/CD-tray/inner-panel scan remains in the accepted right shard. Exact pressing and physical-copy wear are not claimed.
checks: All 54 IDs,positions,album identities,years,confidence,kind,compartments and Spotify IDs match baseline.
Each accepted local artwork path exists and has a corresponding source URL; empty cover/back paths have no stale remote fallback.
51 outer LP backs checked through 15 candidate sheets, ambiguous full-size images, then 3 final canonical contact sheets.

Five non-vinyl back images replaced; true Death and the Flower outerback distinguished from inner gatefold; Journey full exterior isolated to back panel; twofer Mose Allison programme/outerback validated.
limitations: Representative LP edition country/label/printing may differ. Only readable observed catalogue numbers establish a catalogue-family match; matrix/runout data is unknown.
Many archived scans are 600px. Main sleeve content is usable; very small credits may require enlargement or later optional photo.
Views referencefront is a photographed 1975 paperback; actual edition is unknown and source edges are slightly cropped. Book front/back photos remain requested.
Edges 04 and 30 may be neighboring folds; physical independence is unresolved.

guideReadOnlyReview.pairSequence: All manifest pairs/shots align:frontShot=2*pair-1,backShot=2*pair; two faces bind to same stable recordId.

issues.finding: Mobile next-pair navigation leaves the viewport at the previous card’s lower controls; the new physical map/title may be offscreen.
issues.recommendation: Use focus:true/scroll reset when going from a back to the next pair, skipping a fold, or jumping boxes. Same-pair front→back can retain viewport.

issues.finding: Guide view buttons have aria-selected without role=tab; screen readers may not announce which view is active.
issues.recommendation: Use aria-pressed toggles, or implement a complete tabs pattern.

issues.finding: Completion copy states the full sleeve/photo count even after conditional pairs are skipped.
issues.recommendation: Say the planned sequence is complete with up to N pairs/photos, or track skipped pairs before reporting an exact capture count.

issues.finding: Views currently has generic sleeve instructions and only “Book back artwork missing” as its reason.
issues.recommendation: Add the audit’s book-specific actualfront/outerback instruction and edition-uncertainty reason; preserve ISBN/publisher text if printed on back. No extra disc photo needed.

guideReadOnlyReview.browserScope: Source and manifest audit only; no external browser used. Native screenshots were not present in local visuals during this review.
